08049 Shamhuwth {sham-hooth'}

for 08048;; n pr m

AV - Shamhuth 1; 1

Shamhuth = "desolation"
1) the 5th captain (of the military divisions) for the 5th month in
   the time of David
   1a) also 'Shammoth' (08054) and 'Shammah' (08048)
